correctness.rationale: For q odd, unique two-point Hermite interpolation gives q(q−1) ordered rational critical-root incidences. Correction terms are precisely split quadratic squares, counted by qR4(±c)/2, and disjoint irreducible-quadratic squares, counted by qH(±c). A complete fourth-power character analysis handles all odd q including characteristic three. In even characteristic f'=aT²+d and both shifted quartics can be nonsquarefree only when a=d=0, giving q². Inclusion–exclusion gives the pair-squarefree formula. Independent polynomial-gcd enumeration checked 12 fields and 88 shift cases; it is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The motivating finite-field squarefree-pair correlation is a standard arithmetic object but exact fixed-degree shift dependence is not supplied by the closest asymptotic theorem. This classification covers all finite fields, all nonzero constant shifts, exhibits a surprising fourth-power residue split precisely at q≡1 mod8, and isolates characteristic two as the exact independence case. These are natural structural arithmetic invariants, not arbitrary finite computational slices.
